test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Asian Games are held every how many years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Asian Games**, also widely known as **Asiad**, is a continental multi-sport event held every **4 years** among athletes from all over **Asia**.
 
• The event is organized and regulated by the **Olympic Council of Asia (OCA)**, under the supervision of the **International Olympic Committee (IOC)**.
 
• The primary **function** of these games is to foster **international friendship**, **unity**, and **cultural exchange** among **Asian nations** through the medium of sports.
 
• The **Asian Games** follow a cycle similar to the **Olympic Games**, usually taking place in the **even-numbered years** between the **Summer Olympics**.
 
• The **first edition** of the **Asian Games** was hosted in **New Delhi**, **India**, in the year **1951**, featuring **11 nations** competing in **6 sports**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Governing Body Evolution**: Initially, the games were managed by the **Asian Games Federation (AGF)** from **1951** to **1978**. Since the **1982 games**, the **Olympic Council of Asia (OCA)** has been the governing body.
 
• **Recent and Future Locations**:
 
 
• The **18th edition** was held in **Jakarta-Palembang**, **Indonesia**, in **2018**.
 
• The **19th Asian Games** took place in **Hangzhou**, **China**, in **2023** (postponed from **2022** due to the **COVID-19 pandemic**).
 
• The **20th edition** is scheduled to be held in **Aichi-Nagoya**, **Japan**, in the year **2026**.
 
 
 
• **Sports Categories**: The games include **Olympic sports** such as **Athletics**, **Swimming**, and **Archery**, as well as **non-Olympic sports** that are popular in **Asia**, such as **Kabaddi**, **Sepak Takraw**, and **Squash**.
 
• **Participating Nations**: Currently, **45 National Olympic Committees (NOCs)** that are members of the **OCA** are eligible to participate in the games.
 
• **The Symbol**: The official **symbol** of the **Asian Games** is a **red sun** with **16 rays** and a **white circle** in the center, representing the "**Ever Onward**" spirit of the continent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **India's Contribution**: **India** is a **founding member** of the **Asian Games** and has hosted the event **twice**, first in **1951** and later in **1982**, both times in **New Delhi**.
 
• **Medal Standing**: **China** has maintained the **highest medal count** in every **Asian Games** since **1982**, followed by **Japan** and **South Korea**.
 
• **The Asian Winter Games**: Apart from the summer version, there are also **Asian Winter Games**, **Asian Indoor and Martial Arts Games**, and **Asian Para Games**, which cater to different sporting disciplines and athletes.
 
• **Eligibility**: Only athletes from **Asian countries** recognized by the **OCA** can participate, making it the **second-largest multi-sport event** in the world after the **Olympic Games**.
</ul
